description.p: Nira is a comic book and manga reader for the Linux desktop. It opens ZIP/CBZ, RAR/CBR, 7z/CB7, TAR/CBT, LHA and PDF books as well as plain folders of images.

ul.li: Single pages or double-page spreads, and a manga mode that reads right to left
Fit to the window, width, height or size, or zoom by hand, with smart scrolling
A page sidebar with thumbnails, bookmarks, Go to page and a slideshow
Focus mode, a magnifying lens and auto-enhance
A start screen with your reading history; books reopen where you left off
Moving on to the previous or next book in the same folder
Dark and light themes, or follow the desktop
